theme: People & Places in Detail (Non-defining & Reduced Relatives)
phoneme_focus: Intonation dip for non-defining clauses (between commas)

grammar_point.title: Relative clauses: non-defining & reduced
grammar_point.en: Add extra (non-essential) information with non-defining clauses (commas); and reduce relatives to participles.
grammar_point.ar: إضافة معلومات إضافية بجُمَل الوصل غير التعريفية (بفواصل)؛ واختصار جُمَل الوصل إلى مشتقّات.

vocabulary.example: The tower, which is a famous landmark, is old.
The founder, who started small, is admired.
The author, whose books sell well, is Egyptian.
The region, which is mountainous, attracts tourists.
Cairo, which is the capital, is huge.
My colleague, who lives nearby, drives me.
My mentor, whom I respect, retired.
The residents, most of whom are young, love it.
The site has rich heritage.
The monument, built long ago, still stands.
The old district is charming.
The town, situated by the sea, is lovely.
The office, located downtown, is busy.
The house, surrounded by trees, is quiet.
The city, known for its food, is popular.
The area, famous for its markets, is lively.
The bridge, designed by a local, is elegant.
The company, founded in 1990, grew fast.
The inhabitants are friendly.
A key figure, respected by all, spoke.
Her achievement, which inspired many, was rare.
His influence, felt worldwide, endures.
The school has a strong reputation.
My aunt, who is generous, helps everyone.
The staff, dedicated and kind, do their best.
It's a remarkable place.
The village is picturesque.
The bustling market never sleeps.
It's a historic building.
Two cities, namely Cairo and Giza.
The latter is more famous.
The former is older.

Saturday.prompt: Describe three people you know adding non-essential info (…, who …, …).

Sunday.prompt: Describe your city/region with non-defining clauses.

Monday.prompt: Use reduced relatives ('the man sitting there', 'a house built in 1900').

Tuesday.prompt: Present a landmark using several non-defining clauses.

Wednesday.prompt: Introduce an admired figure with detail (whose/whom/which).

Thursday.prompt: Describe a place for a partner to identify, adding extra info.

Friday.prompt: Give a detailed tour of a place + its people (10 sentences) with relative clauses.

writing_prompts: Write three non-defining clauses about people you know.
Describe your region using non-defining relative clauses.
Rewrite three sentences using reduced relatives (participles).
Present a landmark with several non-defining clauses.
Introduce an admired figure using whose/whom/which.
Combine short sentences into one with a non-defining clause.
Write a descriptive paragraph about a place and its people (relative clauses).
